# Winelingo — learn wine, plainly

> Winelingo (winelingo.app) is a wine-education site and companion to the Winelingo iPhone app
> (a free app that scans wine labels and restaurant wine lists and explains each wine in plain
> English — body, tannin, acidity, sweetness and oak). All content is written for beginners in
> plain language, fact-checked, and free. For adults of legal drinking age; enjoy wine responsibly.
